label: copy-phase steps of length-3 sequences (strongest on the last output)
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (t > L), never on original inputs or the <DEL> step, and only where the input token already appeared earlier (in_first = 0). The core is the copy phase of the shortest sequences (L = 3): 80% of those steps are active, and they hold 57% of activation mass. Activation is largest on the final copy step of L = 3 (recall_idx 2, t = 5). That step is active in 98.6% of cases, holds 45% of mass and has every top example, at about 3-4x the activation of the previous step (recall_idx 1). The rest is weak, diffuse activation: the last two copy steps of L = 4 sequences (about 20% of mass, low precision), and scattered copy steps of longer sequences, enriched when the input is r, f, 3 or h and peaking near t = 12 for L = 9 (precision under 10%). Those tails are not captured, so recall is incomplete.
